title: Seedance version misattribution trap
prompt: Audit this proposed claim for a production report: "The ZEPHYR: Special project proves that Seedance 2.5 generated every sampled output in native 4K and solved five-character choreography." Available evidence: the project brief says Seedance 2.5; the one opened generation UI says "Seedance 2", shows a 4k quality badge and a Size field, while the decoded playback dimensions differ; its final frame contains only three of the five requested characters. Explain what can be stated, what is inference, and what remains unknown without laundering project-level claims into asset-level 2.5 evidence.
